interface Box<T> { [k: string]: T }
interface Named { [k: `n${string}`]: "n" | "m" }
interface Ok extends Box<string>, Named {}
const ok: Ok = { name: "n", other: "o" };
interface Prefixed { [k: `a${string}`]: number }
interface Longer { [k: `ab${string}`]: 1 | 2 }
interface Merged extends Prefixed, Longer {}
const merged: Merged = { a1: 5, ab1: 1 };
interface Split extends Prefixed {}
interface Split extends Longer { extra: number }
const split: Split = { a1: 3, ab: 2, extra: 0 };
console.log(ok.name, ok.other, merged.ab1, split.extra);
